paragraphs: Guryon—or, some say, Rav Yosef bar Shemayah: Shabbat 33b. In the name of Rabbi Yose bar Chanina: Jerusalem Talmud, Maaser Sheni, chapter 2, and Nazir chapter 8, halakhah 1. He said, “The people of Magdala asked Resh Lakish”: Jerusalem Talmud, beginning of chapter Benei Hair. Rabbi Yonah went up to him: chapter Megallechin, halakhah 5. He said to Rav Pappa.
